item.tib: ltung bshags dri med mchog byang
item.coloph: tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen pos shar pa rnal 'byor gyi snyan du brgyud pa'i / bshags pa dri med mchog byang bon spyod 'di / rjes 'bring [~'breng] rnams kyi don du yi ger bkod …

item.tib: ltung bshags dri med mchog sbyangs
item.coloph: tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po nas/ shar pa rnal 'byor la snyan du brgyud pa'i bshags pa dri med mchog sbyangs (byang) bon spyod 'di/ rjes 'breng don du yi ger bkod pa dge'o//
